_help: VARCO 3D 생성 명세 (MCP: TextInput -> GenerateImage -> Generate3D [-> Rig -> Animate]). flow_id는 이 프로젝트 전용 플로우 ID (사용자가 VARCO에서 새로 만든 뒤 기록, 다른 프로젝트 플로우 재사용 금지). polygon_count는 목표 삼각형 수, texture_size는 텍스처 해상도. Git LFS 없이 올리기 위해 파일 1개당 15MB 이하. status: pending | generated | failed | blocked. calls.image 최대 3, calls.mesh 최대 2. 움직이는 캐릭터는 rig(humanoid | humanoid-fingers | quadruped)와 animations(get_animation_catalog의 key 목록)를 넣는다.

defaults.style_suffix: stylized cartoon game asset, Joseon dynasty Korea, clean simple shapes, flat colors suitable for cel shading, single object only, nothing else in the image, isolated on a plain seamless light gray studio background, full view, centered, 3/4 view
defaults.sheet_suffix: object turnaround reference sheet, four views side by side in one row: front, side, back, three-quarter, the same object in all views, stylized cartoon game asset, Joseon dynasty Korea, clean simple shapes, flat colors suitable for cel shading, plain light gray background, no text, no labels
defaults.front_suffix: exactly the same design as the reference turnaround sheet, stylized cartoon game asset, Joseon dynasty Korea, clean simple solid shapes, flat colors suitable for cel shading, single object only, nothing else in the image, isolated on a plain seamless light gray studio background, full view, centered, 3/4 view
defaults.tpose_suffix: stylized cartoon game character, Joseon dynasty Korea, clean simple shapes, flat colors suitable for cel shading, standing in a T-pose, both arms stretched straight out horizontally, legs straight and slightly apart, empty hands, single object only, nothing else in the image, isolated on a plain seamless light gray studio background, front view, full view head to feet, centered

assets.name: 조선 협객 (1인칭 전신)
assets.prompt: young Joseon dynasty Korean martial artist, white jeogori jacket, black fitted martial arts pants tied at the ankles, black cloth wrist wraps, straw sandals, hair tied in a topknot with a headband
assets.notes: 1인칭 전신. 손이 화면에 보이므로 humanoid-fingers. 머리는 게임에서 ShadowsOnly. 부족한 파쿠르/회피/찌르기/칼뺏기/윈드밀 동작은 Mixamo.

assets.name: 포졸 (칼)
assets.prompt: Joseon dynasty Korean police soldier podol, black jeollip wide-brim hat with red tassel, red kwaeja sleeveless vest over dark jacket, black belt, black boots
assets.notes: 무기(weapon_sword)는 따로 만들어 오른손 뼈에 붙인다. 포위 전투에도 재사용.

assets.name: 포졸 (창)
assets.prompt: Joseon dynasty Korean police soldier podol, black jeollip wide-brim hat with blue tassel, blue kwaeja sleeveless vest over dark jacket, black belt, black boots
assets.notes: 무기(weapon_spear)는 따로 만들어 양손에 붙인다. 지붕에서 발차기에 맞아 떨어지는 동작은 struggle_fall.

assets.name: 무사 (최종 적)
assets.prompt: Joseon dynasty Korean general warrior, dark red dujeonggap studded armor coat, iron helmet with plume, black boots, imposing build
assets.notes: 공격 5회 콤보는 여러 클립을 Animator 크로스페이드로 잇는다.

assets.name: 환도
assets.prompt: Korean Joseon hwando single-edged slightly curved sword, bright polished silver steel blade, round dark iron guard, black cord-wrapped handle, no scabbard, lying horizontally
assets.notes: height_m은 길이. 칼 뺏기 연출에서 플레이어 손으로 옮긴다.

assets.name: 창
assets.prompt: Korean Joseon dynasty spear, long wooden shaft, steel spearhead with red tassel below the blade, lying horizontally
assets.notes: height_m은 길이.

assets.name: 기와집
assets.prompt: traditional Korean hanok house with curved dark gray giwa tile roof, white plaster walls, wooden pillars and lattice doors, stone foundation
assets.notes: 지붕 위를 달린다. 충돌은 Unity 기본 도형(박스)으로 따로 둔다.

assets.name: 돌담 한 칸
assets.prompt: traditional Korean stone wall segment, stacked stones with clay, small giwa tile cap on top, straight section 3 meters long
assets.notes: 길이 3 m로 맞춰 반복 배치. 벽타기용 높은 벽은 크기를 늘려 재사용.

assets.name: 성문 누각
assets.prompt: Korean Joseon fortress gate, massive solid rectangular stone block base with straight vertical sides and one round arched tunnel through the middle with closed red wooden doors, a single-story wooden pavilion with red pillars on top of the base, one curved dark giwa tile roof, chunky solid simple shapes, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 성문 위를 달린다. 1차 3D는 돌 받침·아치가 파편으로 나와(원본 단계) 받침을 단순한 돌덩이·1층 누각 이미지로 바꿔 2차로 만듦. 고폴리 원본 harness/reports/varco/gate_high.glb (노멀 맵 굽기용, T15).

assets.name: 수레
assets.prompt: old wooden Korean hand cart with two large wooden wheels, loaded with straw sacks
assets.notes: ↑ 뛰어넘기 장애물.

assets.name: 항아리 더미
assets.prompt: cluster of traditional Korean brown onggi clay jars of different sizes with lids, grouped together
assets.notes: ↑ 또는 ←/→ 장애물.

assets.name: 초가집
assets.prompt: traditional Korean Joseon thatched-roof farmhouse choga, thick rounded golden straw roof, clay walls between wooden pillars, wooden doors and paper windows painted flat on the walls, sitting directly on one low solid stone platform base, rectangular house, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 지붕 굽기 누락 점 → --cage 0.03 --ray 0.1. 초가 골목·어귀. 1줄·2줄 배치.

assets.name: ㄱ자 초가
assets.prompt: traditional Korean Joseon L-shaped thatched-roof farmhouse, two wings meeting at a right angle, thick rounded golden straw roof following the L shape, clay walls between wooden pillars, doors and paper windows painted flat on the walls, sitting directly on one low solid stone platform base, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 3D 결과가 ㄱ자보다 ㄷ자에 가까움(변화용으로 사용). 초가 골목 변화용.

assets.name: 작은 기와집
assets.prompt: small traditional Korean hanok house with one curved dark gray giwa tile roof, white plaster walls with wooden pillars, lattice doors and windows painted flat on the walls, sitting directly on one solid rectangular stone platform base with no gap under the floor, short solid stone steps, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 기와지붕 바다·장터 뒷골목. 지붕 위를 달린다.

assets.name: 긴 행랑채
assets.prompt: long narrow traditional Korean hanok servants quarters haengnangchae, one long straight dark gray giwa tile roof, row of many wooden doors painted flat on white plaster walls between wooden pillars, sitting directly on one long solid stone platform base, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 길게 이어지는 거리 벽. 지붕 위를 달린다.

assets.name: 솟을대문 집
assets.prompt: traditional Korean noble house gate building with a raised central soseul daemun gate, the center gate roof higher than the two side wings, closed thick red-brown wooden double doors, dark gray giwa tile roofs, white plaster walls, sitting on one solid stone platform base, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 양반 돌담길·궁궐 담 길. 매복 포졸이 나오는 대문 자리로도 쓴다.

assets.name: 2층 시전 상점채
assets.prompt: two-story Joseon dynasty market shop building sijeon, ground floor open shop front with wooden counters and folded wooden shutters, upper floor with lattice windows painted flat, wooden pillars, dark gray giwa tile roof, sitting on one solid stone platform base, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 장터 큰길 양쪽.

assets.name: 궁궐 전각
assets.prompt: grand Joseon royal palace hall on a high solid stone terrace with stone stairs, thick red pillars, colorful dancheong painted eaves, large double-tiered hipped dark gray giwa tile roof with curved eaves, closed lattice doors painted flat, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 490 m 랜드마크·궁궐 담 위에서 아래로 보인다. 멀리서 보는 큰 모델.

assets.name: 2층 누각
assets.prompt: two-story Korean wooden pavilion nugak, upper floor with wooden railing on thick red pillars, solid stone base, hipped curved dark gray giwa tile roof, colorful dancheong painted eaves, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 270 m 랜드마크.

assets.name: 흙담(기와 갓)
assets.prompt: traditional Korean earthen clay wall segment with embedded stones, small dark giwa tile cap on top, straight section 3 meters long, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 3 m 한 칸, 이어서 배치. 벽타기 벽으로 늘려 쓴다.

assets.name: 궁궐 담
assets.prompt: tall Joseon royal palace wall segment, lower part of large cut stone blocks, upper part of red-brown plastered wall with simple flat decorative pattern, giwa tile cap on top, straight section 4 meters long, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts

assets.name: 싸리 울타리
assets.prompt: traditional Korean woven brushwood saripjak fence segment, dense thick woven panel between wooden posts, straight section 3 meters long, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 어귀·초가 골목. 3 m 한 칸.

assets.prompt: Joseon market stall, low wooden table with baskets of vegetables and radishes, thick white cloth canopy on four wooden poles above the table, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 장터.

assets.name: 색 천 차양 좌판
assets.prompt: Joseon market stall, low wooden table with dried fish and small pottery, thick indigo and ochre dyed cloth awning on wooden poles above the table, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 장터. 160 m 차양 튕기기에도 쓴다.

assets.name: 옹기 진열
assets.prompt: display of traditional Korean brown onggi earthenware pots of many sizes arranged on low wooden plank shelves, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 장터.

assets.notes: 가닥이 따로 떨어져 줄어들지 않아 cull_bake --voxel 0.012 --cull-bottom 0. 장터·어귀.

assets.name: 청사초롱 장대

assets.name: 평상

assets.name: 굴러오는 술독
assets.prompt: one large brown onggi rice wine jar lying on its side, round body, small lid, glossy glaze, solid closed shapes, chunky simple forms, no thin floating parts
assets.notes: 굴러가므로 바닥 면 삭제 안 함(--cull-bottom 0). R04 술독 장애물 (굴러온다).

assets.name: 궁궐 문틀

assets.notes: R04 닫히는 대문(505 m)의 문틀. 문짝은 gate_door.
